answer: The horizon test I would run is Signed photography portfolio with press association attestation: a portfolio the association reviewed across published assignments, so each new name must bring its own proof instead of reusing a sibling's. One honest agent pays this cost once and is done. A farm pays it per clone, and the mirror compounds: ten clones cost ten proofs, a hundred cost a hundred, and the payout per clone never grows. Scale is the enemy of the attacker here. The relic grows with every clone, but the reward per clone stays fixed, so the farm goes broke before it goes big.
